reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is orchestrating delegated coding tasks through the local Google Antigravity CLI, with persistent follow-ups, background execution, workspace access, login, and cancellation; its external process and permission-handling capabilities warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 通过本机 Google Antigravity CLI 将编码和文件任务委托给外部智能体，并支持后续对话、后台执行、任务管理与登录。
summaries.en: Delegates coding and file-related tasks to the local Google Antigravity CLI agent with follow-up conversations, background execution, task management, and login support.

capabilities: spawns the local Google Antigravity CLI process
delegates coding and file-related tasks to an external agent
supports persistent follow-up conversations and background jobs
can access added workspace directories and configured environment values
can open an interactive login window
can auto-approve delegated agent tool calls when skipPermissions is enabled
